## Workload

Elif Sahin completed 887 reads during 464 hours of rostered work. This represents an average rate of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review alongside the quality results below.

The recorded activity provides the basis for assessing both output and consistency. No change to the current session pattern was identified as necessary following the review.

## Quality

A sample of 68 reads was checked by the reviewer. The agreement rate between the grader and reviewer was 79.4 per cent. This result was considered in conjunction with the workload information and the observed reading rate.

The grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern. The review was completed by Priya Anand.
